definitions.explanation: Staying upright in deep water with the head above the surface by moving the legs (and hands), without swimming forward. Taught in Japanese schools and water-safety classes; also a traditional technique of {日本泳法|にほんえいほう}, Japanese swimming arts.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{泳|およ}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{所|ところ}→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立|た}ち{泳|およ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Where I could not touch bottom, I trod water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧まま{立|た}ち{泳|およ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In swimming class we practised treading water with our clothes on.

notes:
{立|た}ち (standing) + ⟦{泳|およ}ぎ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (swimming). Schools in Japan run {着衣泳|ちゃくいえい} lessons (swimming in clothes) where children practise floating and treading water.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{泳|およ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tread water
- {立|た}ち{泳|およ}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: to stay afloat by treading water

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧: breaststroke
- ⟦{背泳|せおよ}ぎ→背泳ぎ：06527_seoyogi⟧: backstroke
